title: Reanimated Remains
description: A death-mechanic mod where your fallen remains are reanimated as a hostile entity. Defeat your own reflection in a challenging duel to recover your inventory.
body:
Reanimated Remains adds a twist to your death. Instead of your items just sitting on the ground, your fallen remains are reanimated as a smart zombie. This entity will rise from your grave, wearing your armor and wielding the weapons you had in your hands.

To get your loot back, you must face your(zombie)self in a deadly duel!

**Key Features**
- Inventory Security: Your items don't just sit on the ground; they are "guarded" by a zombie version of you.
- Dynamic Combat: The zombie uses the same equipment you had at the moment of death.
- Custom Challenges: Recovering your gear isn't just about luck; it's about skill.

**Achievements**
Can you complete them all?
- _Finders Keepers?_: Defeat your reanimated remains and reclaim your lost equipment.
- _Duel of the Fates (Challenge)_: Defeat your reflection while it's fully equipped with Netherite gear.

**Requirements**
- Version: Minecraft 1.20.1
- Loader: Forge

Hope you enjoy my mod
